headline: UAE's Gargash warns of 'prolonged period of uncertainty

sources: Reuters -- 'UAE's Gargash warns of prolonged regional uncertainty, says US-Iran settlement appears difficult' (https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/uaes-gargash-warns-prolonged-regional-uncertainty-says-us-iran-sett
fault_line: Deal or long war? The Gulf's top diplomat says prepare for years of uncertainty -- is Washington fighting a war it cannot end at the table, or is the bridge deal about to prove him wrong?

sections.what_happened: [VERIFIED FACT -- the warning was delivered] Anwar Gargash, diplomatic adviser to the UAE president, told the Abu Dhabi Strategic Debate on Monday that the region should 'prepare for a long period of uncertainty in which neither a decisive resolution nor stable regional order can be taken for granted', and that a comprehensive political settlement between the US and Iran to end the more than eight-month war 'appeared to be difficult'. [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- Gargash's assessment] He said the UAE opposed the US war with Iran from the outset and that the consequences require sustained diplomatic engagement. [ATTRIBUTED REPORT] US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Sunday he did not believe a breakthrough on diplomatic efforts was imminent; Trump has not ruled out new strikes, including at so-called Pickaxe Mountain, a suspected nuclear site Tehran denies is such a facility.
sections.what_verified: 2 distinct publisher families: Reuters (T1 wire) and The National (T2, independently reported from the debate with a different angle -- 'Deterrence and diplomacy needed to counter impact of Iran war'). Khaleej Times also carried the warning but has NO declared tier in the source registry and does not count toward corroboration.
sections.what_disputed: The mediation track contradicts the 'no settlement' read: Qatar's two-day 'bridge deal' (lift blockade + release frozen assets for IAEA access, Hormuz reopens day 2) is on the table and Iran calls it 'the most reasonable proposal' (recorded 1200-01); Trump said Nov 6 'They want to make a deal very badly'; G7 foreign ministers meet in Paris Nov 9-10 pressing Washington against further Iran strikes (recorded 1000-02). Gargash's warning is an assessment, not a verdict on the talks.
sections.why_matters: America's own Gulf ally just said out loud what Washington won't: no deal is coming. The claim-busting frame -- the bridge-deal optimism vs the UAE's verdict of a long, unresolved war.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP -- UAE's Gargash warns of 'prolonged period of uncertainty'; US-Iran settlement 'appears to be difficult' (Reuters 07:01Z = 11:01 ; missed by the 12:00 and 13:00 scans)
